## What changes?
One purpose; explain the user-visible benefit.

## Evidence
- [ ] Local validation and relevant tests pass.
- [ ] Changed behavior has a synthetic positive and negative example.
- [ ] Version-dependent advice cites upstream documentation.
- [ ] Observed results are separate from untested integration.
- [ ] Documentation links and diagrams still match the commands.

## Privacy and scope
- [ ] No private config, raw logs, contacts, device IDs, screenshots, or credentials.
- [ ] No added network access, privileges, or automatic repairs without explanation.

## Limitations / rollback
What is not tested, and how can the change be reverted?
